translations.web: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn.
translations.bsb: But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
translations.kjv: But if they ➔ cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
translations.asv: But if they have not continency, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
